Commit to the Brass Choir route after the First Shift.
Commit to the Rootworks route after the First Shift.
Carry one assembled machine safely through a destination site.

memories.text: Your arm remembers a waterworks. Your bell remembers a factory. Neither remembers being asked to become a weapon.
The bell once announced a shift. Someone later taught it to announce obedience.
The pump did not know who deserved water. It only knew that something downstream was thirsty.
The lens kept what its owners chose to notice, even when the index rejected their names.
The armour was condemned for protecting a worker instead of the production quota.
Before the first command, four incompatible machines chose to keep one another working.
